panels.description: Compares observed metric values against dynamic historical diurnal baseline bands ([μ - 2.5σ, μ + 2.5σ]) computed per hour and day-of-week. panels.description: Calculates voice quality drift velocity (dMOS/dt). Projects forward MOS at 15-minute and 30-minute horizons.
